19 epic pictures from Blackpool's stunning drone show celebrating Stanley Park's centenary festivities

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:51
Instaread
By Jack Marshall

News Editor

Published 3rd Oct 2026, 21:45 BST

Blackpool’s Stanley Park celebrated turning 100 in style.

Blackpool celebrated the 100th birthday of its iconic Stanley Park this afternoon and evening, with a range of event culminating in a stunning drone show which wowed massive crowds.

With people having gathered in their droves earlier in the day to mark the park’s centenary, they were treated to a raft of live entertainment, including performances from Waterloo Women's Choir, local singer and entertainer Emma Jackson BEM, and DJ Jason Fubar, alongside a variety of pop-up performances including stilt walkers, bubble fairy and more for the whole family to enjoy.
